analysis: The trial executed successfully but achieved macro validation HR@10 of 0.4012, below the previous candidate-conditioned model’s 0.4175 and the SASRec reference’s 0.505. Category HR@10 was 0.470 Movies_and_TV, 0.485 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.400 Electronics, and 0.250 CDs_and_Vinyl. Restoring causal self-attention alone did not recover reference performance under the retained training setup. Prefix-only supervision, loss, initialization, and optimization remain possible explanations; the supplied results do not establish the cause. Held-out test performance is unknown.
code_summary: Trained one independent SASRec per category: default 64-dimensional tied item embeddings, learned positional embeddings, two causal attention blocks with one head, dropout 0.5, residual pointwise feed-forward layers, and layer normalization. Candidate scores are dot products with the final sequence representation. Retained prefix sampling, 32 uniform negatives, positive-plus-negative BCE, AdamW, seed 42, validation every five epochs, and 40-epoch patience. The generated predictor preserves all four dataset routes and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category, without ensembling.
